title: On thermal transpiration and thermomolecular pressure difference
summary: In this article, we demonstrate the phenomenon of thermal transpiration in a bounded convex domain. We employ the stationary Boltzmann equation with a cutoff potential. For boundary condition, we partition the boundary into diffuse reflection and incoming regions. We establish the existence of solution in a weighted $L^\infty$ space. Furthermore, we consider a convex domain with diffuse reflection boundary condition in the middle and incoming boundary condition at the two ends.
